website_summary.name: Solar Energy Dashboard
website_summary.description: The website presents a comprehensive solar energy monitoring interface with real-time data visualization and analytics.
website_summary.appearance: The Solar Energy Dashboard features a clean and organized layout with distinct sections for real-time data and historical analysis. The main dashboard includes widgets displaying current power generation (3,500 W), power consumption (3,100 W), and battery status (80%). These widgets use gradient backgrounds and icons for easy identification. Below the dashboard, there’s a section for environmental conditions showing temperature (25°C), wind speed (9 km/h), air quality index (Good), and UV index (6). An energy analytics graph illustrates daily generation and consumption trends with a line chart. On the right side, a sidebar provides a system overview with energy flow percentages, system health status, quick actions buttons, and a data summary including today's generation, daily average, monthly total, and system status. The overall design uses a light theme with subtle shadows and rounded corners for a modern look.
website_summary.functionality:
The website offers several key functionalities:
- Real-time data display for power generation, consumption, and battery levels.
- Environmental condition monitoring including temperature, wind speed, air quality, and UV index.
- Energy analytics with a customizable line chart for daily, weekly, or monthly views.
- System overview with detailed energy flow metrics, system health indicators, and quick action buttons for maintenance and settings.
- Data summary providing insights into today's generation, daily averages, monthly totals, and system status.
- Users can switch between metric and imperial units for environmental data.
- The ability to expand advanced analytics for deeper insights into system efficiency and carbon offset.
